title: Design System: Mauro Cendón Hidalgo — Personal Site

display.purpose: Hero h1 only; carries the gradient cut.

headline.purpose: Page h1 / article titles (3.052rem modular scale).

body.purpose: Reading measure: 720px max-width on blog posts; line-height 1.7.

label.purpose: Nav, button text at sm size, repo language / stars, skill card heading.

shadows.name: ambient-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Bento card hover lift on the homepage.

shadows.name: repo-hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Repo card hover lift inside the GitHub repos card.

shadows.name: chip-elevation
shadows.purpose: Static elevation for the featured-post chip on the blog index.

shadows.name: hero-image-shadow
shadows.purpose: Three-layer blue-tinted shadow; permanent on hero images inside blog posts. Makes the hero image feel like an artifact.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (bento hover, repo card hover, social link hover).

motion.name: duration-lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled confirmation control. The default CTA surface — used sparingly, per the One-Voice Rule.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 0.125rem); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; border: none; outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(21, 128, 61, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Ghost Button (Nav)
components.description: The default nav variant. Carries the header route buttons; quietest of the variants.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 0.125rem); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; border: none; outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--outline) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--primary); border-bottom: 4px solid var(--primary); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Bordered quiet control with hover-muted fill. For secondary actions that should not visually compete with primary CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: calc(var(--radius) - 0.125rem); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid var(--input); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); outline: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); border-color: var(--outline); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--outline) 50%, transparent); border-color: var(--outline); }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: The homepage signature surface. Flat at rest, lifts on hover via the gradient wash and shadow.
components.html:
Key Skills

Full-stack development with an emphasis on efficiency and usability.
components.css: .ds-card-bento { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 0.25rem); padding: 2rem; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-bento::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .ds-card-bento:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10); border-color: var(--primary-accent); } .ds-card-bento:hover::before { opacity: 0.03; } .ds-card-bento > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-card-bento__title { font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--foreground); margin: 0 0 1rem 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-bento__body { font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--foreground); margin: 0; }

components.name: Objective Card (Bento Variant)
components.description: A bento card where the primary token becomes the full-bleed background. Used by the Objectives block on the homepage. Light/dark resolution quirk: in light mode, --primary and --primary-accent both resolve to green-700, so the gradient collapses to a flat green — the gradient only visibly differentiates in dark mode where --primary pivots to Authorize-Blue (blue-700) and --primary-accent to blue-400 (Authorize-Blue Accent).
components.html:
Objectives

To expand my knowledge areas, generate visible and lasting results, adapt to change with ease, motivate teams, and promote effective communication.
components.css: .ds-card-objective { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-accent) 100%); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: calc(var(--radius) + 0.25rem); padding: 2rem; color: var(--primary-foreground); transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-objective__title { font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary-foreground); margin: 0 0 1rem 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-objective__body { font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--primary-foreground); margin: 0; }

photoops

components.css: .ds-card-repo { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card-repo::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-accent) 0%, var(--secondary-accent) 100%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; } .ds-card-repo:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); border-color: var(--primary-accent); } .ds-card-repo:hover::before { opacity: 0.05; } .ds-card-repo > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-card-repo__header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-repo__name { font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--foreground); margin: 0; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-repo__external { opacity: 0.5; flex-shrink: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-card-repo:hover .ds-card-repo__external { opacity: 1; } .ds-card-repo__desc { font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted-foreground); margin: 0 0 auto 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-repo__footer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-top: 1rem; font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-card-repo__lang { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-card-repo__lang-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--primary); display: inline-block; }

components.name: Social Link
components.description: Hero social-link pill (LinkedIn / GitHub) with wash-on-hover gradient and per-brand hover border accent.
components.css: .ds-social-link { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border: 2px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); font-family: 'Karla Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-social-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-social-link:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15); border-color: var(--primary-accent); } .ds-social-link:hover::before { opacity: 0.10; } .ds-social-link svg, .ds-social-link span { position: relative; z-index: 1; } /* Per-brand hover border accents. Explicit exceptions to the two-tone rule; see colors.link-accent-linkedin and colors.link-accent-github in DESIGN.md frontmatter. */ .ds-social-link[data-brand="linkedin"]:hover { border-color: var(--linkedin, #0077b5); } .ds-social-link[data-brand="github"]:hover { border-color: var(--github, #333333); }

components.name: Hero Image (BlogPost)
components.description: The hero image at the top of a blog post — 70% width, 12px corner radius, three-layer blue-tinted shadow that is *permanent* on the image plane (does not respond to interaction). One of the few surfaces with a static shadow by intent.
components.css: .ds-hero-image { width: 70%; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-hero-image__img { display: block; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 0.75rem; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(96, 115, 159, 25%), 0 8px 24px rgba(96, 115, 159, 33%), 0 16px 32px rgba(96, 115, 159, 33%); } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-hero-image { width: 100%; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is laid out like the dashboard a senior engineer would assemble for a hiring decision-maker: each card answers one question, signals are honest, controls behave predictably. Layout is dense without being noisy; motion is purposeful but invisible until called. Surfaces stay calm at rest; lift only signals an interaction. The long-form blog is the proof surface beneath the dashboard — same vocabulary, lower stimulation.

Aesthetic posture: confident, restrained, technical. The site is not trying to impress; it is trying to be useful. Color carries signal, not decoration. Type is a single humanist sans (Karla). The light / dark toggle is a deliberate duality: in light the system reads recruiter-safe and quiet; in dark it pivots the primary to a more capable blue and the secondary to capability-fuchsia, communicating that the same work holds up with different emphasis.
keyCharacteristics: Recruiter-fast. Homepage bento is an answer sheet. Every card answers one recruiter question.
Lift-on-Cue. Borders and tokens carry structure at rest. Translation + shadow appear only on hover, focus, or active state.
Editorial components. Cards have generous internal padding and restrained shadows. Nav and ghost buttons do most of the talking; filled CTAs appear sparingly.
Trust-Green & Client-Safe Blue. Light palette reads reliable, not loud. Capability signals live in the underside color choices, not the surface.
Karla, alone. A single humanist sans carries display, body, and labels. No serif accent, no mono for UI text.
Light by default, dark by intent. The light/dark toggle exists and the dark variant pivots both primaries — it is a duality the user can lean into.

rules.name: The Hero-Gradient Rule
rules.body: The double gradient linear-gradient(135deg, primary → secondary) appears on exactly three places: (1) .gradient-text on the hero h1, (2) .bento-item::before hover wash, and (3) .social-link::before hover wash. Its rarity is the point. Any new use beyond those three is signal dilution.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: In light mode, primary appears on the hero h1 gradient start, the objectives card full-bleed, social link default border, repo language dots, and the link:hover color — roughly 5–6 surfaces in any single homepage scroll. Its density on a single page must not exceed that. Dark mode authorizes a slightly higher density; the same rule of restraint still applies.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Karla is the only UI typeface. Future surfaces that want a second typeface must justify it against the principle Evidence over claim — a second font adds visual noise without serving recruiter-fast reading.

rules.name: The Lift-on-Cue Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Borders carry structure. Translation (translateY(-2px) for buttons, translateY(-4px) for cards) and shadows appear only on hover, focus-visible, or active. Never assign a static box-shadow to a controlled surface.

rules.name: The Wash-on-Hover Rule
rules.body: The hover treatment on .bento-item, .social-link, and .repo-card includes a ::before pseudo-element with linear-gradient(135deg, primary → secondary) and opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease;. Hover lifts opacity to 0.03 (bento), 0.10 (social links), or 0.05 (repo cards). The gradient wash is silent evidence of brand consistency — it should not be replaced with a flat color tint.

dos: Anchor every new surface on var(--primary), var(--secondary), var(--border), var(--muted-foreground), var(--radius-*), and the typography scale. If a new surface feels ready to introduce a token that isn't in the frontmatter, that is a signal to pause.
Default to flat surfaces. Borders carry structure. Reach for shadow only when a state requires elevation.
Use translateY(-4px) + a layered box-shadow + the primary→secondary 135° gradient wash as the canonical hover lift on bento cards. Don't invent a new hover recipe.
Use linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%) on the hero h1 via background-clip: text. That's the brand voice in one move.
Keep the .prose reading measure at width: 720px; max-width: calc(100% - 2em); margin: auto; on blog posts. This is part of the typography contract.
Use rounded-md for buttons, rounded-lg for nav and repo cards, rounded-xl for bento cards, 0.75rem for hero images. These four values are the radii vocabulary.
Test light and dark. The dark pivot (green → blue, blue → fuchsia) is a real duality. A surface that reads in light but fails in dark is not finished.
donts: Introduce a third accent color. The system is two-tone (primary + secondary); the dark pivot authorizes a different two-tone, not a third color.
Use uppercase as a styling device. Labels, buttons, and chips are sentence case throughout.
Add additional portrait imagery. PRODUCT.md binds a single approved portrait at src/assets/images/about/mauro-snow.jpg.
Add box shadows on rest-state cards, buttons, or inputs. Static shadows contradict the lift-on-cue posture.
Paint the footer with extra social icons, links, or legalese. The footer is a closing mark.
Use a serif or mono UI font. Karla is the entire system.
Surface personal-life content (guitar, fishing, music, partner) outside the About page without first re-deciding the binding in PRODUCT.md.
Wire the Donate component into the header or sidebar until PRODUCT.md binds Donate as a real surface or removes it.
Rename or restructure the headline sizes. Display, headline, title, body, label are the five; never collapse two of them.
